committed speech only; reflection/null remain diagnostic
bounded memory query and verified commit inspection
real PTY Cyrillic input, Ctrl+C clear, resize and Ctrl+Q disconnect
80x24 and wide-screen renders; terminal escape sanitization
IPC responsive during inference; queued input and pause before next admission
model-requested scheduled wake commits without a TUI

transport failure pauses and redacts provider body
guarded self profile cannot change without grant
SIGKILL and stale socket recovery; pending attempt resumes only after explicit control
host/database locks, old schema refusal without DB mutation, malformed/oversized IPC
